title: Borel measurability of the straightened slice-Jacobian integrand F̃
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^P of class C¹, B ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} open, χ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} of class C¹ on B, S ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} Borel and g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] Borel. Put S′ := B ∩ χ⁻¹(S) and 𝒥(y) := √det(⟨DΦ(χ y)(Dχ(y)e_{i+1}), DΦ(χ y)(Dχ(y)e_{j+1})⟩)_{i,j<m}, where D = fderiv ℝ and e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Then F̃ := 1_{S′}·(y ↦ g(Φ(χ y))·ofReal 𝒥(y)) : ℝ^{m+1} → [0, ∞] is Borel measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (B : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (χ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl (m + 1)) (S : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞), ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ B → MeasurableSet S → Measurable g → Measurable ((B ∩ χ ⁻¹' S).indicator (fun y => g (Φ (χ y)) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ (χ y) (fderiv ℝ χ y (EuclideanSpace.single i.succ 1))) (fderiv ℝ Φ (χ y) (fderiv ℝ χ y (EuclideanSpace.single j.succ 1)))).det)))
